description: This file defines a Lua module that creates HTML structures for displaying release information, including version links and download options. It includes functions for rendering release lists with formatted version labels and download links based on version comparison.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Generates an HTML list of release versions with links or unread status, styled with optional CSS classes.

methods.name: Releases
methods.description: Creates a section containing multiple release entries, including download links for different platforms.
